column1: # M0 baseline: unported LuaJIT 2.1 (base 63c8f1a9) vs PUC-Lua 5.4.9, aarch64.
# Reasons are triaged by root cause and tagged with the phase that fixes them.

column3: PENDING VM WORK: pcall/xpcall nesting bound and __call-chain argument prepending are on branch wip-calls-vm; mode A also stops at line 359 (arbitrary _ENV). The message-handler re-entry bound is in this commit.
P5: debug.getinfo(1,"t").istailcall must be true without a hook; Fable tail marks exist only while a call hook is installed (db.lua:619). nups/getlocal now match.
PERF/memory: reference needs near 8G and OOM-kills the box; excluded from the default corpus discovery, run alone with --include-heavy on a >8G box.
IMPL-DEFINED: dump/reload border bug FIXED and rawlen added; only the runtime-built sparse-table border differs (any border is legal per the 5.4 manual)
P1.8b: tail-call error names -- LuaJIT reuses the caller frame, so the loaded-module fallback reports 'string.rep' where 5.4 reports the short 'rep'. Non-tail and pcall paths match.
IMPL-DEFINED: LuaJIT runs __gc only for userdata, not tables (PUC 5.4 finalizes tables); gc options now match
IMPL-DEFINED: runtime-built sparse tables may report any legal border (5.4 manual 3.4.7); LuaJIT's array-growth policy differs from PUC's alimit hint
FORK: private dump format (JITLua-5.4 fork); PUC 5.4.9 cannot round-trip it, mode R checks ours
